text: Without a capacity limit, target K of two produces the same partition and cutsize three. With capacity two, the result has three clusters and cutsize eight. The difference of five comes exactly from A to C and B to C becoming cross-cluster edges. If target K is three instead, that same capacity-two result successfully reaches the target.

cues.en: Without a capacity limit, target K of two produces the same partition and cutsize three.
cues.zh: 没有容量限制时，目标 K 为二仍得到相同分组，割边权重总和为三。

cues.en: With capacity two, the result has three clusters and cutsize eight.
cues.zh: 容量为二时，结果有三个簇，割边权重总和为八。

cues.en: The difference of five comes exactly from A to C and B to C becoming cross-cluster edges.
cues.zh: 多出的五，恰好来自 A 到 C 和 B 到 C 两条边变成跨簇边。

cues.en: If target K is three instead, that same capacity-two result successfully reaches the target.
cues.zh: 如果目标 K 改为三，那么同一个容量为二的结果就成功达到目标。

boundaries.text: Without a capacity limit, target K of two produces the same partition and cutsize three.
With capacity two, the result has three clusters and cutsize eight.
The difference of five comes exactly from A to C and B to C becoming cross-cluster edges.
If target K is three instead, that same capacity-two result successfully reaches the target.
